question_pt: Quais sao os 10 CIDs de infarto agudo do miocardio mais frequentes nas internacoes?
sql: SELECT c."CID", c."DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'I21%' GROUP BY c."CID", c."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10
